1.EN:
Huh, there's a shrine here?
I pass by here all the time, but I never noticed.

2.EN:
Yes! I think the fact that there's a shrine right next to Electric Street
is one of the most interesting things about this city.

5.EN:
...Shrines aren't exactly supposed to greet folks like that,
but y'know. Whatever.

6.EN:
You clap twice at a shrine, right?

I forgot to change out of my maid dress before coming,
but hey, free exposure for the cafe, I guess! ♪

Ya want a thrivin' business?

ya get better results by prayin' at a nearby shrine
instead of someplace way over yonder.

Why don't you make an offering?

18.EN: (I wish for Fuwa Fuwa's business to be smooth-sailing...)

"Huh? Uh, no,
I work at a cafe called Fuwa Fuwa..."

33.EN:

because the truth is always within the great Favna.

(Uh-huh... But she did guess that I was a store manager,
and she somehow knew she would meet me here.)

37.EN: (Does she really have some sort of mysterious power...?)

41.EN:
There's no need to return it.

42.EN: And I stopped searching for it once I knew it was in your hands.

51.EN:

It will protect you and your allies.

100.EN: (The great catastrophe...? What's going to happen...?)

101.EN:
(I guess I'll have to take good care of this pendant

You snap out of your stupor and find yourself at the shrine.

111.EN:
Nope, he can't even answer...
I'll have to do somethin' about the ghost first...

A pendant... Are ya tellin' me to use it?

All right, it's gone for now.

117.EN:
Did I use it too forcibly?

Seeing you collapsed on the ground, Honoka holds you gently.

"But that pendant...
What will I even say to Favna tomorrow?"

121.EN: Sounds like that pendant's important to ya...

122.EN:
It must be somewhere close.
I'll help ya look for it! It's the least I can do.

124.EN:
I'll go look over at the main building!
Tell me if there's anythin' I can help ya with!

127.EN:
(I'd be too ashamed to talk to Favna if I lose the pendant.
I have to find it somehow.)

131.EN: (Oh, there's a storm drain here. Could it be in the drain...?)

132.EN:
You look down at the drain and notice a red glint among the mud and leaves.
The pendant seems to have fallen into the drain.

133.EN: (It's so narrow and muddy... I'll need a tool for this...)

134.EN: A tool? What do ya need? Take your pick!

136.EN: You borrowed a laundry pole from Honoka.

137.EN: You borrowed a shovel from Honoka.

139.EN:
You see the pendant at the bottom of the drain.
You try to pick it up with the tool you borrowed.

140.EN: "I should be able to reach it with this laundry pole..."

141.EN:
But the mud and leaves make it hard to see where the pendant is.
You should do something about that first.

142.EN: "The mud and leaves are in the way. I'll clean it out first."

143.EN: You use the shovel to clear the area of mud.

144.EN:
Now all you have to do is get the pendant out!
You should be able to get it by hooking it up with a long pole.

145.EN:
"Can the back scratcher reach the pendant?
I'd like to give it a shot, but..."

146.EN:

the back scratcher isn't long enough. You should probably try something else.

147.EN: "Finally. Time to get the pendant out of the drain."

149.EN: You borrowed a laundry pole from Honoka.

150.EN: You borrowed a shovel from Honoka.

151.EN: You borrowed a back scratcher from Honoka.

153.EN:
...You can reach the pendant, but not get it out.
If only you had something that could hook it out easily...

155.EN:
...Nope. The drain is too narrow for the shovel to fit inside.
You should try a different tool.

156.EN: "Maybe this back scratcher can reach it...?"

157.EN: ...No, it's too short! If only it was a bit longer...

158.EN: "Well, too bad. Maybe I should try a different tool..."

159.EN: "Excuse me, do you have any other tools?"

160.EN: I'm sorry, but this is all we've got...

161.EN:
...Oh, but there's a general store nearby, right?
Maybe they've got somethin' useful!

162.EN: "That's right! Thank you, I'll go take a look!"

163.EN:
Wow, that's a retro-lookin' doohickey you got there.

164.EN: "This should do it...! Don't let me down, Ultra Catcher...!"

165.EN:
You extend the Ultra Catcher as far as it can go,
but the drain is deeper than you thought.
You'd have to stick your hand inside to reach the pendant.

166.EN: (I have work tomorrow, so I can't stay here all night...)

168.EN:
A-Are ya sure...?
You're gonna get yourself all muddy...

169.EN: (The drain is so muddy, and the smell might get on my clothes...)

171.EN: ...! I see... It's really, really important to you, ain't it...

172.EN:
"It's not exactly mine...
But I promised its original owner that I would keep it safe!"

173.EN:
You reach in as far as you can, ignoring the dirt that gets on you.
You feel the Ultra Catcher grasp the pendant firmly!

174.EN: "Just a little bit more...! I got it!"

176.EN:
Ohhh, thank goodness!
I was on the edge of my seat! You got me all anxious, too!

177.EN: "Thank you for helping me get the pendant back."

178.EN:
Ehehe, don't worry 'bout it.
Buuut, I wouldn't say no to somethin' in return~

179.EN: "Haha... If there's something I can help you with, I'd be happy to."

180.EN:
(I should think long and hard about
that supernatural phenomenon just now...)

181.EN:
You finally reach your apartment after a rather eventful night
and rest your weary body...

183.EN: Well? How is my familiar faring?

185.EN:
......I see. I had also predicted it somewhat,
but to think he would go to such lengths...

186.EN:
...Ah, this is truly the work of fate.
I can hardly wait until the day we forge our pact...

188.EN:
There you are. Come...
It is time for us to start the ritual.

189.EN:
(...She's wearing her maid dress. She does look pretty good in it...
Maybe she's taken a liking to it?)

190.EN:
As you do as Favna says and stand in front of her,
she starts reciting a strange incantation.

191.EN:
Now, we shall form an eternal pact written in blood,
and sever the cursed chains of the false god who binds us,
rearranging the gears of an unfortunate fate...

193.EN:
As the Slayer of the False God, the Queen of the Kingdom of Darkness,
the All-Seeing Oracle, the Guardian of All Dreams—
I, Favna, command you.

196.EN:
...The pact is complete. From now on, we are bound together forever,
no matter how many years may pass, or how many lives we are reborn in.

197.EN: "Thank you...? Is that the right thing to say?"

198.EN:
"That was an incredible performance.
I never guessed that the pendant could light up like that!"

201.EN: ...Well. You will be convinced one day. I will make sure of it.

203.EN:
Evil spirit, begone! Evil spirit, begone!
Doman! Seman! Doman! Seman!

205.EN:
...Ack! Who...
Oh, you're the manager of Fuwa Fuwa...!

206.EN: "Is this... salt? What are you doing?"

207.EN:
Uhh... I'm just doin' a bit of purification here 'n' there.
Y'know, since we're a shrine, and it needs to, uh, stay pure!

208.EN: It's nothin' special, really! Just business as usual!

209.EN:
(Really...? She's just tossing salt everywhere.
That looks like it'd be a hassle to clean up later...)

211.EN: Uu... Pleeease let this be enough...

212.EN: Huff, huff... Phew, that was horrible...

215.EN:
Nonoka-chan and Nanoka-chan told us everything!
Are you all right?

216.EN:
Ah, yes, don't ya worry...
A bucket just fell outta the sky, that's all.

217.EN:
The evil presence is growing even stronger...
This place is dangerous.

218.EN:

Just what in the world did you do?

221.EN: ...Ohh, stop it! Stop lookin' at me like that!

222.EN:
I'm completely fine 'n' dandy! I don't need no help!
I can deal with this on my own!

223.EN: Y'all are sweet, but please just leave me alone...!

Go past here, and you'll be in the evil spirit's territory.

227.EN: Wait, no! Don't get too close...!

229.EN: (It's happening again! I can't move my body...!)

231.EN:
This dark suppression...!
Th-There really IS something here that doesn't belong in this world!

233.EN: (...?! A girl's voice...? Where's it coming from...?)

234.EN: ......Why... are you getting in the way...

236.EN: Manager! Oh no, what do we do...?!

237.EN: Uhhhh! W-We should get outta here, and fast!

239.EN: I-I shall lend a hand as well!

244.EN:
Ohhh, thank goodness.
I wouldn't know what to do with myself if I'd gotten ya got hurt...

245.EN: Thanks so much for helping out, Honoka-chan!

246.EN:
"Yeah, you were a huge help.
Especially since it must've been so scary for everyone..."

247.EN:

248.EN: "Wait, but you looked pretty scared just now..."

I heard strange noises, and I know we all couldn't move for a while,
but I didn't actually see anything. Was there really a ghost...?

251.EN: "...I'm positive there must be a ghost. Because I..."

252.EN: "For just a moment... I heard her voice."

255.EN: I'm terribly sorry for pushin' this onto your shoulders.

256.EN:
That pendant is the proof of our pact.

257.EN:
"I'll be fine. And I'm sure you guys will
save me again if anything happens, right?"

258.EN:
Duh, of course we will!
We won't let anyone hurt you!

259.EN: G-Ghosts are scary... but you can count on us, Manager!

263.EN: (I can move... And I can hear her voice clearly!)

265.EN:
The ghost shows herself in front of the hokora at the back of the shrine.
Her voice and expression are heavy with sadness.

267.EN:
"I'm sorry for what we've done to you.
I want to find a peaceful solution to this."

268.EN: You're weird... What are you trying to do...?

270.EN:
We're sorry for what we did to ya,
but this here shrine is important to us...!

271.EN: I'm afraid of ghosts, but... I want to try being friends!

274.EN:
Everyone says they'll be my friend...
But in the end, everyone forgets all about me...

275.EN: You're no different...! You shoved that THING in my face and laughed at me...!

277.EN:
...I'll let you go, just this once.
But don't come back, or else...

279.EN: ...You really are weird. I suppose I could tell you one thing...

280.EN:
...My name is Miyako Noto.
...Not that anyone would recognize that name...

282.EN:
...We don't seem to have been teleported anywhere.
We must have just fallen unconscious.

283.EN:
"...She looked so sad. You can tell she's been
suffering for a long time... I feel sorry for her."

285.EN: Th-Then... Should we keep at it, for just a li'l longer?

286.EN:
In Shinto, death is said to cause "kegare," or defilement...
But I can't just leave her alone after seein' her like that.

287.EN:
Now that I've seen her mopin' around,
I wanna help turn her frown upside down!

289.EN:
The ghost might think you're a nuisance...
But Electric Street is all about togetherness and helping each other out.

290.EN:
I tried to think of ways I could help, but in the end,
I reckoned I should do my job as a daughter of the shrine.

291.EN: Honoka shows you a piece of paper cut into the shape of a person.

292.EN:
This is a "hitogata." I'll transfer my sins and defilement to it
so it can receive judgement in my place.

293.EN:
My sin... is not even gettin' to know the ghost
before I started tryin' to exorcise her.

294.EN: It's not exactly a present, but it represents my remorse and my desire to make amends.

295.EN: "Acknowledging your mistakes like that is real admirable, Honoka."

296.EN: It's nothing that needs flatterin'. I could only do this 'cause I'm not alone.

297.EN:
Still... thanks. I can't exactly say that I ain't scared,
but I feel a li'l braver with y'all with me, for sure!

298.EN: You arrive at the shrine once again.

299.EN:
Take caution. The spirit is likely to still hold resentment in her heart.
She might restrict our movement the second we enter her territory.

300.EN: I thought I told you to never come back...

301.EN:
"We're sorry; we didn't mean to impose on you when
we don't even know the first thing about you!"

303.EN:
We can't just leave ya alone, y'know?
Especially not now that we know why ya passed...

304.EN: I'm surprised to hear there's someone who still remembers my name...

305.EN: We're here today to show our sincerity.

306.EN:
Honoka shows the ghost her hitogata—
the paper doll she had transferred her remorse into.

307.EN:
I was wrong to assume ya to be an evil spirit
that needs exorcisin'. I want to make it right by you.

308.EN:
With the regret in my heart, I'll cast this into the river to purify.
I hope it'll help with yours, even if just a little.

309.EN: But if ya won't forgive me...

310.EN:
Then I'll never forget this grave mistake.
It's nothin' impressive, but this is the most I can do...

311.EN: Do you... really care that much about me...?

312.EN:
"The other girls are just as worried about you.
These gifts should show you that they're completely sincere."

314.EN: Here you go! It's a photo I took with the most moe maids in the city...!

315.EN:
Are you making fun of me...?!
Get that out of my sight!

317.EN: I picked this out just for you. I didn't know what else I could do...!

318.EN:
Flowers...
No one's ever given me flowers...

319.EN: I hope this aroma and light will guide your way...

322.EN: I've always been alone... There's no way I can be saved just like that...

324.EN: "We have other gifts for you. Take a look at this."

326.EN: Here you go! It's a photo I took with the most moe maids in the city...!

327.EN:
Are you making fun of me...?!
Get that out of my sight!

329.EN: I picked this out just for you. I didn't know what else I could do...!

330.EN:
Flowers...
No one's ever given me flowers...

331.EN: I hope this aroma and light will guide your way...

333.EN: Friends... I have no idea what that entails...

334.EN: But... I can tell... that you aren't my enemies...

336.EN: This shrine... was the last place I remember visiting before I fell ill...

337.EN: If I can let go, then I can move on to the other side. But...

338.EN: ......No, I can't say it. I can't admit that THAT'S what's keeping me here...

339.EN: Wait... Are ya embarrassed about it?

340.EN: "Is this related to the reason you can't move on?"

341.EN: Miracle Maid polaroid:option25;Delinquent manga series (full set):option26

342.EN: O-Oops, I couldn't help it... Spreading the good word, and all...

343.EN:
Wow, this brings me back...
All I did in the hospital was read manga all day.

344.EN:
If you're talking delinquent manga,
then I loved "B-Bout Blues"!

345.EN:
Wh-Whoa! Talk about old-school...
You're one of the real fandom oldies...!

346.EN:
I see, so this is the kind of delinquent manga
that's popular right now... I wanna read more!

347.EN: ...Uh, she sounds like she wants to stay in the mortal world now...

348.EN: "Please don't! No more manga, look at this instead!"

352.EN:
So frilly... so elegant... so cute...
Their outfits are so lovely...

353.EN:
"Your regrets must have something to do with maid dresses; 
otherwise, you wouldn't have said what you did that time..."

354.EN: You're no different...! You shoved that... that THING in my face and laughed at me...!

355.EN:
"You were talking about the time I came here with Shiro and Miyu.
You saw them pray at the shrine in their maid dresses!"

358.EN: I... I also wanted... to wear a cute frilly outfit like that...!

359.EN:
I wanted to lift up a little white apron, do a little curtsy, 
and say, "Welcome home, Master!" with a cute smile on my face...!!

360.EN:
But ya couldn't go outside in your final days,
and even after death, you're stuck here at the shrine...
Ya couldn't do the things ya wanted to do...

362.EN: Of course not! Hang on, we'll bring you a maid dress right now!

363.EN: It's a classical maid dress! It's what we wear at Fuwa Fuwa!

364.EN:
Ohhhhh my gosh... The skirt flows so beautifully...! And it's so elegant!
The waitresses I admired used to wear something just like this!

365.EN: Manager! Help her put it on!

368.EN:
"I... guess we should've seen this coming,
but she slipped right through the dress."

370.EN:
So is this it? Am I stuck like this forever...?
It's my fault for getting attached to something so silly...

374.EN:
I still have one more trick up my sleeve.
Never thought I'd ever have to use it, though...

375.EN: R-Really? Even though I've already caused you so much trouble...?

378.EN:
I... I want to wear a maid dress!
Just once! Please...!!

379.EN:
Don't worry, I'll help ya.
I'm the one who'd feel bad if ya didn't move on.

381.EN: I'll get ready, so wait for me.

382.EN: "Got it! But promise to ask us for help if anything happens, okay?"

383.EN: Ya really are a big softie... Thanks, though.

384.EN:
Having finally made peace with the ghost,
you call it a day and rest with a warm sense of relief...

386.EN: Remember how I said I had a trump card?

387.EN:

The Spirit Channeling Technique.

389.EN: I never really believed in it either...

390.EN:
And it's said that the technique only works on spirits
that the user's on good terms with... which shouldn't be a problem here.

391.EN: "I see. I think it's worth a shot!"

392.EN:
But to do that, I need the secret scrolls that contain
the instructions on how to use the technique.

394.EN: It's exactly what you're fearin'. They're gone!

395.EN:
I reckon we lost 'em durin' spring cleanin'.
I cleaned the bookshelves with my sisters...

397.EN: No, no. Daddy took it to the used bookstore.

398.EN: But I can't remember which store it was...

399.EN:
(There's a used bookstore nearby.
It could still be there. I should go check!)

400.EN: Sorry to keep ya waitin'. Is this all right?

401.EN:
YOOOOOOO!! A real-life shrine maiden?!
That's so POGGERS!!

404.EN:
I just happen to have a li'l prop on me too...♪
Would ya like an omamori for 1000 yen?

407.EN:
Huff, huff... Oh, right, I almost forgor.
Here's the dusty ol' zine I promised.

408.EN: Obtained: Scroll of Spirit Channeling, Volume 4

409.EN: Well then, my work here is done...

410.EN:
"...Wait a minute!
Didn't you buy another scroll here?!"

411.EN:
Wehhh, not this one too!
I want it for my collection...

412.EN:
Pleeeease? ...Or maybe we could
trade ya somethin' in exchange?

413.EN:
Well... there's this doujinshi by a popular doujin artist
that I really want... It was online order only...

414.EN:
It sold out instantly and never got reprinted...
But I can't put money into the pockets of filthy resellers!!

415.EN:
Would you happen to have a copy of... the legendary
"Is the Order a Little Sister?" all-character high school AU doujinshi
by the one and only "Holy Hanpen-sensei"?!

416.EN: "Uhh... there's no way we'd have something THAT specific..."

424.EN:
YOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOO!!

425.EN:
Aw, hush your mouth! It's not that good, anyway,
both the art and plot are so juvenile... It's embarrassin'...

426.EN:
Nuh-UH! The art is obviously god-tier, that goes without saying,
and the AU is so well-thought out it's obviously made out of love for the series,
you wouldn't believe how many times I've cried over it...!!

so it's really motivatin' to hear that.

I'd be happy to give ya a copy if that's how much ya like it.

You gave the otaku the doujinshi of his dreams

Augh... sob sob... Finally... Holy Hanpen-sensei's doujinshi...

Sensei! You're going to SummerComi, right?
GOOD LUCK HAVE FUN KICK THEIR BUTTS~!!

433.EN:
Yeah. It's kinda embarrassing that I got exposed
as a doujin artist in front of ya, though...

Anyway, let's deal with our ghost friend's problem first,
and then we can enjoy the summer festival!

"Five of the living shall surround the dead
and offer them a prayer in unison."

443.EN:

Four shall stand in the directions of the pig, the dog, the rooster, and the monkey,
and a shrine maiden shall stand in the direction of the sheep."

444.EN:
"When heaven hears the prayer,
the spirit of the dead shall descend to earth."
...That's it.

I didn't expect something so occultish...

449.EN:

451.EN: Okay, then I'll stand right... here!

455.EN: My turn. Do you know which direction the rooster is in?

460.EN: "This should be the right place. Let's move on."

461.EN:
And lastly, the shrine maiden... That's me.
I'll have to stand in the direction of the sheep, which is...

Hoo! This is gettin' wilder by the minute...

464.EN: Are you guys ready? You'll have to say the prayer first...

465.EN:
(...Kashikomi kashikomi mo mousaku...
...With great respect and humility...)

Ohmigosh, it's sooooo cuuuuute!!!

480.EN:
"She's reacting to her cute outfit...?
Wait, does that mean...?!"

482.EN:
I'm borrowing this girl's body for now.
Looks like the spirit channeling was a success!

483.EN: Woohoo! Good for you, ghost girl! And Honoka-chan too!

My body feels so light...
I've never been so agile before! Ohhh, I'm so happy!

Let's get the maid outfit out...

I want to enjoy the maid outfit in the best possible scenario...

Ever since the ghost left Ishida Shrine,

511.EN: Heeey~! Then I'm keeping mine a secret too!

530.EN:
I came up with an idea for a suuuper auspicious collab
between Ishida Shrine and Fuwa Fuwa, see.

531.EN:
Imagine if we sold omamori blessed with the moe power of cute maids...
I can already see them sellin' like hotcakes!

532.EN: If we join forces, we'll definitely make a fortune!

533.EN: "Hahaha... Then I'll be counting on you."

534.EN: "Let's get along as neighbours from now on too, Honoka."

537.EN:
From now on, we're business partners, not just neighbours!
And we're teammates of Fuwa Fuwa!

538.EN: Does that mean you'll join us and be a part of Fuwa Fuwa too?!

539.EN:
I mean, maid dresses are still a li'l embarrassin'...
But the time I spent in Fuwa Fuwa was real warm and cozy.

540.EN:
Besides! Our shrine would become the one and only shrine

541.EN:
Ishida Shrine would get so much attention and go viral
and earn loads of money! Yep! I'm a genius!

542.EN: And everyone wins! What a wonderful idea!

545.EN: Well then, I'll be countin' on you from now on, Manager! ♪

The shrine's gettin' a lotta visitors thanks to the festival,

not even I could tell what you were wishing for...
